generator: backend/_server_legacy_impl.py _write_lidar_demo_scan (POST /api/live-scan/demo/load): samples LIVE_SCAN_DEMO_ASSETS[part].scan_mesh_relpath (test_files/<part>/scan.stl) with Open3D, subsamples to point_count (default 14000), adds N(0, noise_sigma_mm=0.08) jitter, drops ~6% of points, writes binary PLY xyz-only to live_scans/<part>_LIDAR_DEMO_<YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS_ffffff>.ply
method: Checked every scan row in merged_inventory.json (360 path rows, 128 scans): PLY header (Open3D comment, properties, face count), vertex count, file mtime vs the name stamp; then point-to-source-mesh distance for every LIDAR_DEMO file. No other Open3D-header file in the inventory matches the signature (the other Open3D files are the 3 already-excluded synthetic fixtures with 3500/5000 points, and sc_2e584e9d1ffe, 43468 points with normals, already flagged POSSIBLE_CAD_REFERENCE_MESH).
gold_note: None of the 9 files is in Gold11, Gold37 or physical15 (prior_use other-consumed, no gold_lines/Gold11 basis; parts 47266000 and 11979003 have in_gold11/in_gold37/in_physical15 = false). Gold unchanged.
